278820355.description:
Lot of five loose mineral and crystal specimens for display or collecting. Included are a purple amethyst druzy cluster on gray host rock, a citrine point cluster with golden tips on white quartz, a raw pink rose quartz chunk, a large pale yellow calcite piece with green inclusions and a small polished banded jasper pebble. Each piece is unmounted with natural rough surfaces, and no labels or paperwork are included.

Condition: Natural rough edges, small nicks and surface pitting throughout. Light dust and a few darker mineral spots. Identifications are estimated as no labels are present.

278752345.description:
Sheaffer
Ballpoint Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set - Pepsi Advertising Edition
1980s Era, Black Matte Finish with Gold-Tone Trim
This vintage Sheaffer writing set represents a classic piece of 1980s corporate advertising history, featuring the iconic Pepsi "Choice of a New Generation" branding. The set consists of a ballpoint pen and a mechanical pencil, both finished in a professional matte black with elegant gold-tone hardware. As a collaborative piece, it combines Sheaffer's mid-century reputation for reliable writing instruments with the bold marketing aesthetic of one of the world's most recognizable beverage brands.
Matte black barrel construction with contrasting gold-tone clips and decorative bands
Custom Pepsi globe logo emblems mounted on the pocket clips
"PEPSI. THE CHOICE OF A NEW GENERATION." printed in gold-tone script on the pen barrel
Each instrument measures 5" in length and includes the original Sheaffer presentation box
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The matte black finish is well-preserved with only minor surface handling marks. The gold-tone trim remains bright, and the Pepsi logo inserts are intact with vibrant color. The mechanical components of both the pen and pencil are functional. No testing has been performed on the ink supply or lead capacity. The original box is included and shows light storage wear.

Also featured are polished and rough mineral and gemstone specimens, including blue and brown banded agate slices, a yellow/orange tumbled stone, a small geode, and a rectangular metallic mineral sample. Additionally, there is a resin pyramid with decorative inclusions. Items are in good vintage condition with minor wear; the elephant has a small chip on the ear. Suitable for collectors of minerals, gemstones, and Inuit or Indigenous art.
